item.title: Making the case for a new system: why it's really about how we talk
item.description: In this post, I use Conway’s Law to explain why departments keep building their own systems — and share a checklist for deciding whether you should. Again!? You wanna build another new system? If you are a data scientist working closely with IT team, you have probably heard this complaint. “Why does everyone in the house want to build their own new system?” — an IT manager said this to me.
